title: Every test runs with temporary relay and Claude folders
what: Every test, by default and without asking, runs with HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and RELAY_HOME pointing at a temporary folder, so a test that forgets to set them cannot read or write the owner's ~/.claude, ~/.relay or ~/.claude.json. A test that needs the real folders says so explicitly. One test proves the default: a test that writes into claude_dir() leaves the real folder untouched.
why: Owner, 26 Oct: "Но я бы все равно подумал, возможно мы бы добавили конфигурацию путей, по умолчанию глобально, для тестов указываем tmp директорию". Facts, 26 Oct: the path configuration exists in lib/relay_config.py (ROOT via RELAY_ROOT, HOME_DIR via RELAY_HOME, CLAUDE_DIR via CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, default the user's folders); 15 of 70 test files set these themselves; there is no tests/conftest.py, so nothing sets them by default. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
where: tests/ a shared fixture every test gets by default
lib/relay_config.py ROOT, HOME_DIR and CLAUDE_DIR and their override variables
